raw_increment: d = original COUPLED U/V minus HYDRO U/V on the existing free faces
center: bP = independently verified continuous nearest equal-face Euclidean projection of d using original PR99 frozen-carrier per-layer A; its stored wind must reproduce archived PROJECTED byte-for-byte
control_support: Existing receipt-bound fixed five-cell QC buffer; a free U/V face has both adjacent mass columns inside; every exterior horizontal increment remains zero at all levels
equality: A_k b_k = 0 at all native levels; preserve the nonzero HYDRO reference divergence
distance_norm: Global equal-free-face Euclidean velocity norm over both components and all native levels; squared units m2 s-2, inherited from PR99 projection; not a kinetic-energy or covariance norm
additional_change_budget: Delta = norm(d - bP); require 0 < Delta < norm(bP); norm(b - bP) <= Delta; total source distance <= sqrt(2)*Delta by projection orthogonality
storage_reserve: Before solve, bound REAL32 round-to-nearest wind error on the allowed componentwise box HYDRO + bP +/- Delta; subtract its global L2 upper bound from Delta; require positive continuous radius. Check actual stored wind readback strictly against the original Delta
objective: Minimize integral of squared geometric finite differences of the additional grid-component wind, not the total HYDRO wind
horizontal_edges: Each same-component neighboring face pair uses physical distance DX/mean(MAPFAC_*X) or DY/mean(MAPFAC_*Y); edge weight is mean geometric face dual volume divided by distance squared; include free-to-fixed-zero boundary links
vertical_edges: Same native face between adjacent mass levels; center heights from PH and PHB read separately and pinned source gravity; edge weight is mean geometric face dual volume divided by center-height separation squared; natural end levels, no invented vertical ghosts
dual_geometry: Face area DX*DY/(MAPFAC_*X*MAPFAC_*Y), face depth from adjacent-column average of native interface heights; finite, positive metrics/depths and monotone heights required
objective_units: Unnormalized squared-gradient functional m3 s-2; horizontal and vertical terms have the same units. Optional one positive global trace normalization changes only objective scale, not the constrained minimizer
operator_limit: A geometric roughness proxy for native grid components; not the complete WRF diffusion, covariant strain, momentum or energy operator
weight_selection: No forecast-dependent parameter search or response-fit weights. A bracketed trust-region multiplier is determined solely by the fixed distance constraint; it is not an experimental candidate sweep
background_error_authority: No case-bound authorized wind covariance or spatial correlation scale identified; the inherited projection-displacement envelope is an engineering research bound, not a statistical prior or observation-error acceptance threshold
candidate_admission: All variables, dimension definitions, global attributes and variable metadata outside U/V values unchanged from original PROJECTED
Verify full A feasibility, nearest-projection normal-space condition, trust region, storage bounds and nonzero increment
Verify archived native calc_ww_cp on exact candidate and inspect actual C2 first mass/momentum source response before640 launch
Reuse existing closed C2 OFF/HYDRO/COUPLED/PROJECTED 640 controls with identical exe/boundary/namelist; no model-physics or input-thermodynamic change
assessment: Report predeclared fixed613support and five-cell buffer, native first-step source metrics and common history times, without redefining favorable regions or using OFF as truth
